title: Puttering Pebblepus
statement: An ink-blue octopus with copper freckles putters through a tank of milky glass arches, soft white sand, and long ribbons of green, carrying pebbles tucked into its curled arms. Beneath a puddle of amber light, it assembles elaborate spirals, pauses to consider them, then moves just one stone—occasionally abandoning the whole enterprise to investigate its own reflection.
